title: sybil-attribution: simulation code for Roster or Reputation? Attributing Sybil Resistance to Mechanisms in Secure Clustered Wireless Sensor Networks
description: MATLAB/Octave simulator, experiment drivers, raw results and Python analysis scripts for the FEIC 2026 paper 'Roster or Reputation? Attributing Sybil Resistance to Mechanisms in Secure Clustered Wireless Sensor Networks: A Simulation Study'. A 2x2 factorial ablation of a registration roster and a behavioural trust veto in secure clustered wireless sensor networks, with forged identities and compromised hardware counted separately.
